shots.action: A woman with long wavy brown hair looks forward and speaks.
A man in a maroon shirt looks down a corridor with pipes on the ceiling.
The man looks up while the woman stands behind him.
The woman looks forward with a concerned expression.
The man looks up at the pipes on the ceiling.
A close-up shows the man looking up with a focused expression.
The woman stands behind a desk with a laptop and looks forward.

Four white pipes with valves are shown mounted on a concrete wall.
The man reaches out towards the wall pipes while the woman watches from behind.
